item.title: EU funds departments face uncertain future under reform plans
item.description: A group led by former Secretary-General Catherine Day wants the Commission to work across directorates instead of in silos. Commissioner Serafin must give final recommendations to von der Leyen by the end of 2026.

item.title: Five unions call strike for 5 November as student blockades resume
item.description: The CFDT, CGT, FO, UNSA and FSU back the students' right to protest and join their demands over wages and public services. The government calls the blockades unlawful.

item.title: Russia vetoes renewal of UN mission for Western Sahara
item.description: MINURSO's mandate expires on 31 October after Moscow blocked a US draft that would have cut the mission's military component by at least half. Morocco's Royal Cabinet says the mission's personnel should leave the southern provinces in the coming days.

item.title: Officials fear heavy Russian shelling of Kherson resumes on Monday
item.description: The pause ends late on 1 November. Soldiers say lorries, Grad launchers and drones show Russia is preparing a bigger attack.

item.title: Commission wants to triple Frontex to 30,000 officers and 11.8 billion euros
item.description: The plan adds a quick reaction force and a bigger role in returns. Member states and Parliament must still agree, and most states saw no need for a big enlargement in February.
